component.name: Fastshot
component.summary: Powerful yet simple to use screenshot software
Мощный и простой инструмент для скриншотов

description.p: Fastshot is a Flameshot-style screenshot tool written in Rust. Select an area, annotate it with the tools placed around the selection and copy the result to the clipboard, save it, pin it on the desktop or upload it.

ul.li: Pencil, line, arrow, rectangles, ellipse, marker, text, pixelate, counter and invert tools
Undo/redo, movable and editable drawings, color wheel and side panel
Copy to clipboard, save, pin, open with an application, upload to Imgur
Tray icon, launcher, delayed and full screen captures, command line interface
